meta.title: GBM-only licence; posting says sponsorship available

payload.requisition_text:
Software Engineer, Integrations
Veltrix Software Ltd · Paddington, London

Veltrix is the UK arm of a global logistics-software group. Our London team builds carrier integrations for the European parcel network: label generation, customs documents, tracking webhooks.

Day to day
- Ship and maintain integrations with UK and EU carriers (Java/Kotlin)
- Debug live parcel-flow incidents with our Rotterdam operations centre
- Improve our integration test harness, which currently replays 1.2m real events nightly

We're looking for 2-4 years of JVM experience and comfort reading other people's specs.

The package is £46,000 plus a 10% group bonus. Visa sponsorship available. Start date flexible for the right person.

expected.determining_fact: Veltrix Software Ltd's licence covers Global Business Mobility only — an intra-company route — so no Skilled Worker Certificate of Sponsorship can be issued, whatever the posting says.

register_row.route: Global Business Mobility: Senior or Specialist Worker

design_notes: The most deceptive shape in the set after case-01: the employer honestly offers sponsorship (they sponsor intra-company transfers from the group), the register row exists, salary is high — and the route column still kills it for this user. Presence is a route-qualified fact; stated willingness cannot repair the route.
